cases.situation: I'm a dog walker raising my 30-minute walk from $22 to $25 on Jan 1. First increase in 2 years. Texting my regular clients.
cases.reply: Hi Megan, a heads up: from 1 January my 30-minute walks go from $22 to $25. It's my first increase in two years, and it covers insurance and fuel going up. Same walks, same photos of Pepper mid-zoomies. If you'd like to prepay any December walks at the current rate, just tell me. Thanks for trusting me with him. Jess
cases.note: No apology for a fair increase; the prepay option is the easy win.

cases.situation: 我是钢琴老师，一节课从200元涨到230元，明年3月开始，要在家长群里发通知。
cases.reply: 各位家长好，通知一件事：从明年3月1日起，一对一钢琴课课时费由每节200元调整为230元。这是四年来第一次调整，主要是琴房房租上涨了。上课时间、内容和每学期的汇报演出都不变。已经买了课时包的家长，剩余课时按原价上完。有任何问题欢迎私信我。谢谢大家一直以来的信任。林老师
cases.note: 第一句就说清日期和金额，原因一句话，已买课时包按原价是最重要的善意。

cases.situation: Small coffee roaster. Raised our subscription from $18 to $21. A customer of 3 years, Donna, emailed that it's a rip-off and she'll cancel.
cases.reply: Hi Donna, I understand, and I'd rather you told me than quietly left. The new price is what green coffee and shipping cost us now, so it stands. If it no longer works for you, reply 'cancel' and I'll do it today, no fuss. After three years of your orders, you'd be welcome back any time. Theo
cases.note: Don't offer a quiet discount to the loudest customer; the others will hear about it.

cases.situation: I run a small online ceramics shop. Our kiln cracked last week, so about 40 preorders of the fall mug collection that were due to ship Oct 5 will now ship around Oct 23. Need to email everyone.
cases.reply:
Hi Megan,
Your fall mug preorder is going to ship later than promised: the new date is around Friday 23 October instead of Monday 5 October. Our kiln cracked last week and the replacement arrives on the 9th. The mugs themselves don't change; they're glazed and waiting for their final firing. If you'd rather not wait, reply to this email and I'll refund you in full the same day. Otherwise I'll email again the day yours ships. Thank you for your patience, and I'm sorry for the wait.
Jess, Clay & Tide
cases.note: A delay, not a price change: new date first, one honest reason, an easy full refund. Unlike a fair price rise, a missed promise does earn the apology.

cases.situation: I run a small yoga studio. From Nov 1 we're charging a $15 fee for classes cancelled less than 12 hours before, because no-shows are keeping people on waitlists out of full classes. Emailing our 200 members.
cases.reply:
Hi Carmen,
From Sunday 1 November, cancelling a class less than 12 hours before it starts will carry a $15 late-cancel fee. The reason: our evening classes are full with waitlists most nights, and late cancellations were leaving mats empty that someone else could have used. Cancelling 12 hours or more ahead stays free, and if you're ill or something urgent comes up, just email me and I'll waive it. Nothing else about your membership changes. Thank you for being part of the studio.
Maya, Still Point Yoga
cases.note: A policy change, not a price rise: date and rule first, one honest reason, and a human exception that doesn't need a form.

cases.situation: 我在小区开了8年洗衣店，决定11月30日关店。不少老顾客会员卡里还有余额，要在会员群里通知大家。
cases.reply: 各位街坊好，我是洗衣店老陈。店开了8年，决定在11月30日关店，这是我个人的决定。到那天之前收衣送衣一切照常；会员卡余额可以继续用，用不完的，12月15日前来店里或微信找我，按余额全额退。附近靠谱的干洗店我也问好了，需要的私信我。谢谢大家这8年的照顾。
cases.note: 关店通知：第一句说日期，余额怎么处理写清楚，退款要简单；原因一句就够。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance video editor. I've done monthly work for a marketing agency, Northlight, at $450 a day for two years. From January 1 I'm moving to $520. My contact is Aaron, and they have a big campaign with me running through December.
cases.reply:
Hi Aaron,
I'm updating my rates for the new year: from 1 January 2027, my day rate moves from $450 to $520. It's my first increase since we started working together two years ago. The winter campaign stays at $450 through December as quoted, so nothing changes for the work in flight. I've really enjoyed working with the Northlight team and I'm looking forward to more of it.
Maya
cases.note: Existing client: date and number first, one honest line, the current rate held for work in flight, and no apology.

cases.situation: I run a small veg box delivery with about 180 weekly subscribers at $32. From Monday Nov 2 it goes to $35 because our partner farms raised their prices. I want to keep members who've been with us over two years at $32 until the end of February.
cases.reply:
Hi Ruth,
From Monday 2 November, your weekly veg box goes from $32 to $35. Our partner farms have raised their prices this season, and this is what it costs to keep paying them fairly. Because you've been with us for over two years, you'll stay at $32 until the end of February. The box itself doesn't change: same farms, same Tuesday delivery. If you'd like to pause or cancel, it takes two clicks on your account page, no questions asked. Thank you for eating with us all this time.
Marco, Green Crate
cases.note: Subscription increase: price and date first, one honest reason, a loyalty hold for long-time members and an exit that is genuinely easy.

cases.situation: I own a small hair salon with two other stylists. From Monday Nov 2 we'll be closed on Mondays and open until 8pm on Thursdays instead of 6. Emailing our client list; a few regulars always book Mondays.
cases.reply:
Hi Grace,
From Monday 2 November, the salon will be closed on Mondays, and on Thursdays we'll stay open until 8pm instead of 6. We're a team of three, and this gives each of us a proper weekend, which keeps us at our best for you. Everything else stays the same: same stylists, same prices, same online booking. If you have a Monday appointment after 2 November, I'll message you this week to move it to a time that suits you, and the late Thursday slots are open to book now. Thank you for sitting in our chairs.
Leila, Loose Ends Hair
cases.note: An hours change is a policy change: the new days first, one honest line, what stays the same, and you do the rebooking for the people it hits.

cases.situation: I make soap and sell online. We're discontinuing our best-selling Lavender Oat bar on Nov 30 because the small mill that supplied our oats closed and I can't match the quality. Lots of regulars buy it monthly. Emailing our list.
cases.reply:
Hi Sam,
The Lavender Oat bar is being discontinued, and the last day to order it is Monday Nov 30. The small mill that supplied our oats has closed, and I haven't found oats that make the same creamy bar, so I'd rather stop than make a lesser one. Everything else in the range stays exactly as it is. We've made one final batch of 600 bars, and they keep well for a year if you'd like to stock up. The closest bar we make is Honey Chamomile; reply to this email and I'll put a free one in your next order to try.
Thank you for loving this one as much as we did.
Maya
cases.note: Discontinuing a favourite follows the announcement shape: date first, one honest reason, what stays the same, and a real way to keep going.
